title: Merged-PR-linked advection flux-boundary witness for JAX-CFD

source_case_schema.source_function: small boundary-condition tuples for velocity, advected scalar, flux direction, and grid axis

parameters.old_rule: advection flux inherits the advected scalar boundary condition
parameters.corrected_rule: advection flux boundary condition is inferred from velocity and scalar boundary conditions
parameters.primary_witness: normal no-penetration velocity boundary with scalar Neumann boundary

transformation_preconditions: The subject computes advection flux across a boundary.
The velocity boundary condition is available in the flux direction.
The boundary is either periodic or a homogeneous no-penetration wall.
The external merged PR documents the flux-boundary semantic correction.

boundary_condition_compatibility.reason: JAX-CFD PR #167 states that advection flux boundary conditions are now correctly inferred from velocity boundary conditions and adds get_advection_flux_bc_from_velocity_and_scalar.

output_mapping.description: Compare the old scalar-boundary inheritance rule with the corrected velocity/scalar inference rule for flux boundary conditions.

metric.name: advection_flux_boundary_consistency
metric.formula: old_matches_expected = old_flux_bc == expected_flux_bc; corrected_matches_expected = corrected_flux_bc == expected_flux_bc

exclusion_rules: Exclude claims about full JAX-CFD solver accuracy.
Exclude non-constant or unsupported boundary-condition classes not covered by PR #167.
Exclude defect-rate claims across JAX-CFD or differentiable CFD libraries.

verdict_interpretation.pass: The PR artifact is present and the witness reproduces the old scalar-BC inheritance mismatch and corrected flux-BC inference behavior.
verdict_interpretation.fail: The artifact checks or boundary-condition contrasts contradict the PR-linked semantic correction.
verdict_interpretation.skip: The run was not executed because source artifacts were unavailable.
verdict_interpretation.out-of-relation-domain: The target boundary condition is not a supported periodic or homogeneous no-penetration case.
verdict_interpretation.numerical-tolerance-issue: Not applicable to exact boundary-condition labels, but retained for schema consistency.
verdict_interpretation.inconclusive: The external PR link or semantic witness evidence is incomplete.

claim_limitations: This MR card supports one external merged-PR-linked boundary-condition semantic witness for JAX-CFD advection flux handling. It does not report full solver validation, production CFD correctness, or a real-world defect-detection rate.
